outcomes.queuePreparationExitExplanation: Intentional SIGTERM to its identified diagnostic Peer after a real report was left queued; restart fault action, not a failed assertion.
outcomes.regressionSignalEvent: A SIGTERM intended to cancel the still-unadmitted wrapper raced with admission. No requeue/retry occurred; pnpm/Vitest continued, all 117 tests passed and command exited 0.

limits: Exact deadline tests use a synthetic monotonic clock with real Peer cuts, tx-range and queue.
